props.name: inset
props.description: When `true`, keep the chip inside the wrapped element (no edge nudge).

props.name: position
props.description: Corner the chip is anchored to. Defaults to `top-right`.

props.name: show
props.description: Hide the chip itself; the wrapped child still renders. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: standalone
props.description: When `true`, render the dot without the relative wrapper (no overlay).

props.name: text
props.description: Optional text/count rendered inside the chip — turns the dot into a pill.
